user.title: Connect to LG TV
user.description: Enter the IP address of your LG TV. A pairing prompt will appear on the TV — accept it with your remote.

reconfigure.title: Re-pair LG TV
reconfigure.description: Re-pair with the TV to refresh its connection key (needed after a TV factory reset invalidates it). A pairing prompt will appear on the TV — accept it with your remote.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect. Make sure the TV is on and on the same network.
error.pairing_timeout: Timed out waiting for pairing. Turn on the TV, start again, and accept the prompt on screen.
